quarterly_data.signal: Record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $2.03 billion, up 30% year-over-year (26% excluding the extra week, which contributed approximately $65 million); product revenue of $987 million was up 51%; gross profit a record $1.43 billion (+29%), operating margin 31.9% and EPS $2.58, up 66%.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue $2.03 billion, +30% YoY (+26% ex extra week); product revenue $987 million, +51%

quarterly_data.signal: All-Flash Array revenue reached $1.31 billion in Q1, up 47% year-over-year, as customers standardize on NetApp for mission-critical workloads including GPU-intensive AI pipelines; management also sees a resurgence of hybrid flash as customers move lower-priority use cases from flash to hybrid flash in the higher-price environment, but all-flash remains the predominant driver.

Won approximately 350 AI and data lake modernization deals in Q1 (GPU-connected, AI-stack-connected deals), with deal sizes increasing as customers move from proof of concept to production; wins include a public sector deal using NetApp AFF integrated with NVIDIA SuperPOD, an Asian Neocloud provider (displacing existing vendors for customer-facing AI inference services) and a significant agreement with Samsung Electronics for its EDA environment and AI Center of Excellence.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 350 AI and data lake modernization deals in Q1

quarterly_data.signal: Product gross margin was 54.6%, down 150 basis points sequentially, mainly on higher component costs partially offset by better pricing; NetApp has adjusted pricing as commodity prices rose and the impact of price increases now materializes much sooner than the historical two to three quarters; inventory expanded on strategic purchases to secure supply for demand growth, with inventory turns of six.
quarterly_data.figure: product gross margin 54.6% (-150 bps QoQ); inventory turns 6

quarterly_data.signal: FY2027 revenue guidance raised to $7.975 billion-$8.225 billion (midpoint $8.1 billion, 17% growth, an increase of $650 million versus prior guidance) with EPS of $9.73-$10.03; Q2 revenue guided to $2.1 billion ± $75 million (23% growth at midpoint) with gross margin 67%-68% and operating margin 30.9%-31.9%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2027 revenue $7.975 billion-$8.225 billion (+17%); Q2 $2.1 billion ± $75 million

quarterly_data.signal: Management sees a clear structural improvement in the underlying demand environment alongside some accelerated purchase decisions and pricing benefits: a small set of very large customers kitted out multiple data centers within a quarter ('two of the four' this calendar year) — not a material part of the business — while the budget priority for data infrastructure and storage has gone up significantly; the broad-based acceleration in capital spending is called 'a sign of the AI super cycle'.

Public cloud revenue of $206 million grew 28% year-over-year (19% adjusting for the extra week) on first-party and marketplace storage services such as Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP and Azure NetApp Files, with public cloud gross margin of 86.4%; remaining performance obligations were $5.65 billion, up 14%, and deferred revenue $4.85 billion, up 7%.
quarterly_data.figure: public cloud revenue $206 million, +28% YoY; RPO $5.65 billion, +14%

quarterly_data.signal: AFF is built for the very high end of performance and scale and is focused on the AI GPU-as-a-service category (Neocloud, a government agency building a private AI cloud), with fewer but material-sized transactions and certification across a large number of customers; NetApp acquired DataPelago (Nucleus in-place data processing engine for AI) in Q1 and JetStream (cloud-native VMware disaster recovery) at the start of Q2, and will showcase new AI, Neocloud and sovereign-cloud solutions at NetApp INSIGHT in September.

connects_to.relationship: NetApp AFF disaggregated all-flash storage integrated with NVIDIA SuperPOD AI infrastructure

contracts.signal: A public sector organization awarded NetApp a strategic deal to modernize and expand its intelligence capabilities and deliver real-time analytics, leveraging NetApp AFF integrated with NVIDIA SuperPOD.

connects_to.relationship: NetApp storage supplied for Samsung Electronics' EDA environment and AI Center of Excellence

contracts.signal: Signed a significant agreement with Samsung Electronics to support its EDA environment and AI Center of Excellence.

contracts.signal: A U.S. hospitality company adopted NetApp technology for the first time through Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP, supporting its large-scale VMware migration to AWS; NetApp has also brought block storage and lower-cost price points to multiple clouds including Amazon.

contracts.signal: A U.S. public sector organization selected Azure NetApp Files as part of its data modernization efforts, overcoming technical barriers found in other cloud services and enabling substantial cost savings; the JetStream acquisition adds seamless replication of VMware workloads to Azure NetApp Files.
